shortDescription: Download SentinelOne agent from Management Console

options.name: agent_version
options.description: Version of the agent to be downloaded. B(latest) (default) - download latest GA (stable) release for the specified parameters B(latest_ea) - same as latest, but also includes EA packages B(custom) - custom_version is required when agent_versioin is custom

options.name: architecture
options.description: Architecture of the packet which should be downloaded If not set 64 bit agent will be downloaded. If set to B(aarch64) the ARM64 agent will be downloaded

options.name: custom_version
options.description: Explicit version of the file to be downloaded Has to be set when agent_version=custom Will be ignored if B(agent_version) is not B(custom)

options.name: download_dir
options.description: Set the path where the agent should be downloaded. If not set the agent will be downloaded to the working directory. If the directory does not exists it will be created

options.name: os_type
options.description: The type of the OS for which the agent should be downloaded

options.name: packet_format
options.description: The format of the packet which should be downloaded

options.name: site
options.description: Name of the site from which to download the agent If omitted the scope will be on account level

options.name: token
options.description: SentinelOne API auth token to authenticate at the management API
